links.outcome: LLM classifier accuracy in identifying answerable, deferral, and nonanswerable heart failure queries

links.quote: The pipeline first uses an LLM-based classifier, achieving 65% accuracy for answerable and helpful deferral queries and 100% accuracy for identifying nonanswerable queries.
